rationale: Daily long-only Bollinger Band mean reversion was tested because downside deviations below a volatility band may mark oversold BTCUSDT conditions that revert toward the recent mean, while long-only exposure avoids assuming symmetric short-side mean reversion. Daily bars were expected to reduce noise and turnover. RETROSPECTIVE: this plan was authored after execution as part of WP-6c to extend the schema grammar to the remaining concluded candidates. The original H-003 pre-registration lives in research/hypotheses/H-003/HYPOTHESIS.md and was not schema-validated at the time.
hypothesis_to_test: A daily long-only Bollinger Band mean-reversion strategy on BTCUSDT perpetuals will generate OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs, capture oversold daily reversion without relying on short exposure, keep turnover low enough that cost drag remains within D2-006 limits, and survive walk-forward validation with efficiency > 0.5.

additional_criteria: OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs
Gate 2 passes under current evaluator semantics: dsr_val > 0.95 versus the expected maximum-SR benchmark from the registered trial count
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline
No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL
Kill criteria from H-003 HYPOTHESIS.md apply: OOS Sharpe < 0.3, max drawdown > 35%, cost drag > 50% of gross PnL, or entries clustered into too few historical regimes

data_requirements: BTCUSDT funding rates full history supplied for funding cashflows: data/processed/binance_um_perp_BTCUSDT_funding_8h_2019-09-10_2026-04-12_2026-04-12T1655Z.parquet
No separate IS/OOS split convention existed in repo truth for this baseline; DEC-0003 records full-period Sharpe in both trial-log Sharpe fields
